entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. It's... well, it's not working and I'm just so confused.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. I can definitely look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
It's Sarah Evans. The order number is... umm, let me see... VF9012-5C.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, I don't really know the difference. It's just supposed to work, right? It doesn't track my heart rate correctly. It's basically just expensive `garbage`.
I understand your frustration. It sounds like a technical fault. The good news is we can usually fix that with a quick reset. Do you have a few moments to try some troubleshooting steps with me?
Troubleshooting? Oh, no... I really `don't have time` for all that technical stuff. I get so overwhelmed. Can't you just help me? I `just want money` back, I just want a `refund`.
I see. You're reporting a defect but prefer not to troubleshoot. Let me check the return eligibility for you. One moment while I pull up the policy.
Okay Sarah, I've reviewed your order and our policy. I see the item was delivered 26 days ago.
Is that bad? I don't really understand how this works.

Not at all. According to our knowledge base, all VeloFit items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you are well within that 90-day window, I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund.
Oh! You can? That's... wow, that's such a relief. I was so worried. Thank you so much.

Of course. I'm happy I could resolve this for you. I'm sending an email right now with a pre-paid shipping label and instructions. Just place the item back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off. Your refund will be processed once we receive it.
Okay, that sounds easy enough. Thank you again, Charlie. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you!
Have a wonderful day. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
